name: Tech Sell-off
sources: Yahoo Finance daily bars via Firecrawl, 16–20 Nov 2026: SNDK, MU, AMD, DELL, AVGO, ANT, NVDA, ^GSPC (US closes), GC=F (COMEX Dec 26), BTC-USD (UTC day, still open when captured)

segments.title:
Red Friday
for tech
segments.say: Friday was brutal for tech stocks. The S&P 500 fell more than 3 percent, and chip makers got hit hardest. Here's what actually happened.

segments.title: Chip stocks crushed
segments.say: Sandisk fell 16 percent. Micron, 14. AMD, 13. Nvidia and Broadcom, about 12 and a half each.

segments.title: Not just chips
segments.source: Yahoo Finance: DELL, ANT, BTC-USD (UTC), GC=F
segments.say: Dell lost almost 12 percent. Anthropic, on only its second day of trading, fell almost 10 percent, to 87 dollars 65. That is still above its 83 dollar IPO price. Even Bitcoin and gold dropped.

segments.title: S&P 500 this week
segments.say: Zoom out to the week, and the S&P 500 dropped from 7,416 on Monday to 6,949 on Friday. That's down more than 6 percent in five days.

segments.title: What we can't confirm
segments.say: As I found out, viral posts claim 2.7 trillion dollars was wiped out. I couldn't verify that number, or a confirmed reason for the drop. And many of the percentages going around were mid-day snapshots. The closing numbers were actually worse.

segments.title: If you invest

cards.text: Don't panic-sell on one red day
cards.sub: big drops happen in every market

segments.say: What does it mean for you? One bad day is not a trend, so don't make decisions in a panic. Check official closing prices, not screenshots. And spread your money, because this storm hit one sector the hardest.
